sections.title: Needs a person
sections.note: Breached first, then overdue, due soon, benchmarks and checks. Each line cites its source.
sections.sql: select level, what, record, issue, source from attention order by case level when 'breached' then 0 when 'overdue' then 1 when 'due soon' then 2 when 'benchmark' then 3 else 4 end, what

sections.title: Forecast renewals against the renewal budget, 30 years
sections.note: Assets already below satisfactory fall in this year: that is the backlog.
sections.sql: select fy_label(financial_year) as year, forecast_cents, budget_cents, gap_cents, cumulative_gap_cents, currency from funding_gap order by financial_year

sections.title: Assets due for renewal in the next five years
sections.sql: select fy_label(financial_year) as year, code, name, class, area, grade, criticality, cost_cents, currency from renewal_forecast where financial_year < fy_of(current_date) + 5 order by financial_year, cost_cents desc

sections.title: Share of replacement cost by condition grade
sections.sql: select class_code as class, class as name, assets, grc_cents, grade_1_percent, grade_2_percent, grade_3_percent, grade_4_percent, grade_5_percent, not_graded_percent, currency from condition_profile order by class_code

sections.title: Below satisfactory
sections.sql: select code, name, class, area, grade, condition, criticality, cost_to_satisfactory_cents, planned_work, currency from backlog order by criticality desc, cost_to_satisfactory_cents desc

sections.title: Wearing out faster than their age says
sections.sql: select code, name, class, age_years, useful_life_years, grade, condition from asset_register where wearing_fast order by consumed - age_consumed desc

sections.title: Sector ratios
sections.note: Past years use actual spend; this year and later use the budget.
sections.sql: select fy_label(financial_year) as year, basis, renewals_ratio_percent, essential_services_percent, maintenance_ratio_percent, backlog_ratio_percent from ratios

sections.title: Depreciation by class
sections.sql: select class_code as class, class as name, sum(grc_cents)::bigint as grc_cents, sum(accumulated_depreciation_cents)::bigint as accumulated_depreciation_cents, sum(carrying_cents)::bigint as carrying_cents, sum(annual_depreciation_cents)::bigint as annual_depreciation_cents, max(currency) as currency from asset_register group by class_code, class order by class_code

sections.title: Revaluations
sections.sql: select code, name, revaluation_years, last_revalued_on, due_on from revaluations_due order by due_on

sections.title: Inspections due in the next 60 days
sections.sql: select code, name, class, area, criticality, inspected_on, grade, inspection_due_on, days_overdue from inspections_due where inspection_due_on < current_date + 60 order by criticality desc, inspection_due_on

sections.title: Open defects
sections.sql: select number, asset, asset_name, area, risk, status, reported_on, respond_by, description from defects_open order by case risk when 'extreme' then 0 when 'high' then 1 when 'medium' then 2 else 3 end, reported_on
